world.b: An explosion hit Yemen's capital as Houthi missiles were intercepted over Riyadh. Follow Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Three oil tankers reported hit around Oman’s Khasab

world.h: DR Congo Ebola cases pass 12,000 as fighting disrupts response
world.b: Response workers have been forced out of affected areas as clashes intensify in eastern Congo's Ituri province, officials said.
world.title: DR Congo Ebola cases surpass 12,000 as fighting disrupts response in east

world.h: Kim calls for wider deployment of tactical nukes
world.b: North Korea's leader said tactical nuclear weapons should be deployed 'across multiple domains' as he inspected nuclear material production sites, state media said.

world.h: Ukraine says it hit five planes at Russian air base
world.b: Ukraine's General Staff said it struck the Savasleyka airbase east of Moscow, damaging three MiG-31s and two Su-34s.
Israel's caretaker prime minister called for an immediate end to his trial after judges cast doubt on the charges and recommended dropping the bribery case.

world.h: Fuel truck fire kills at least 30 on Cairo ring road
world.b: A vehicle carrying petroleum products overturned and caught fire above a tunnel in Giza's Warraq district, Egypt's health ministry said; 15 were injured.

world.h: Iraq's top court lets Baghdad take over Kurdish borders
world.b: The ruling lets federal troops deploy to borders in the Kurdish region, a day after the prime minister ordered forces to take over Kurdish-run crossings and oil fields.

world.h: Solomon Islands bars foreign bases in Australia treaty
world.b: Solomon Islands signed a sweeping treaty with Australia affirming it will allow no foreign military bases, seen as a blow to China's regional ambitions.

national.h: Storms snarl Thanksgiving travel on both coasts
national.b: Tens of millions face airport and highway delays; high tides flooded California streets and damaged Pacifica Pier as an East Coast storm moves north.
national.title: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed

national.h: Judge blocks FCC review of ABC station licenses
national.b: Judge Loren AliKhan found the FCC's early review of Disney's ABC licenses was unconstitutional retaliation for coverage Trump dislikes.
national.title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump

national.h: Plane crash off Mississippi kills Florida family of 6
national.b: The small plane was returning from a fishing trip when it crashed Tuesday; pilot Brent Stokes, 50, was among the dead, the coroner said.
national.title: Small plane crash off Mississippi coast kills extended family of 6 on fishing trip

national.h: Ábrego García leaves for Spain, hopes to return

national.title: Ábrego García, a Salvadoran mistakenly deported by U.S., goes to Spain but hopes to return after Trump

national.h: FDA to expand testing of prescription drugs
national.b: The FDA will test more drugs for impurities and quality lapses after a ProPublica investigation found it rarely tested generics doctors had flagged.
national.title: FDA to Expand Prescription Drug Testing After ProPublica Revealed Safety Concerns

national.h: Army calls Iowa lead azide detonation a success
national.b: Army officials said Wednesday's controlled detonation of 68 drums of volatile lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant 'wildly exceeded' expectations.

national.b: Abrego Garcia, wrongfully deported to El Salvador last year, left voluntarily after months fighting a second deportation to Africa.

politics.h: Trump open to meeting El-Sayed on Medicare for All
politics.b: Weeks after attacking him on the campaign trail, Trump says he will meet the incoming Democratic senator to discuss a national healthcare program.

politics.h: Judge orders Fulton County to give 2020 records to state board
politics.b: A Fulton County judge ordered a digital copy of ballots and records seized by the FBI delivered to Georgia's State Election Board, under a protective order.
politics.title: Georgia's Fulton County ordered to give copy of 2020 election records seized by FBI to state board

politics.h: Alaska ends voter data deal with Justice Department

politics.title: Alaska ends voter data agreement with Justice Department, which had been searching for noncitizens

politics.h: Poll: Most voters want Iran war ended now

international.title: Ukraine drone attack kills five in Russian-occupied Zaporizhia

international.h: Explosion at Bangkok oil refinery injures seven

international.title: Seven injured in explosion at oil facility in Thailand’s Bangkok

international.h: Kenyan court faults US-backed Ebola quarantine site

international.title: Kenya gov’t violated constitution with Ebola quarantine site, court says

international.h: Israeli attacks kill eight in Gaza, including education official

international.h: Iraq denies troops moving toward Kurdish region

international.h: Puerto Rico's top court ends Luma Energy contract

international.h: ISIL suicide attack kills two Syrian security officers
international.b: Four gunmen attacked a checkpoint in Hasakah on Wednesday, killing two security personnel and wounding five; all four attackers died.

international.h: Tinubu vows peace for Nigeria's northeast ahead of vote
international.b: At a rally in Maiduguri, President Bola Tinubu promised to restore peace to the rebellion-hit region as he seeks a second term on January 16.

international.h: Ecuador and US review joint military operations
international.b: The US paused operations in Ecuador pending an investigation into one carried out by Ecuadoran forces that raised human rights questions.

international.h: UK moves warplanes into hangars over drone threat

international.h: Saudi Arabia downs Houthi drones

international.b: The Defence Ministry and security officials warned companies supplying Ukraine's military that they could be targets of Russian sabotage.

business.h: South Korea raises interest rates amid chip boom

business.b: The PCE index rose 3.8% from a year earlier in October, and core inflation also accelerated, moving farther from the Fed's 2% target.
business.title: Rising inflation strengthens case for Fed rate hikes

business.h: Portland man's free newsletter tracks grocery prices
business.b: Bryan Vance has tracked 20 staples at more than a dozen stores since April 2025 in his Stumptown Savings newsletter, as food costs climb.

business.b: The proposal adds 20% to tariffs on Chinese goods and raises them on the EU, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and nine other trading partners.

business.b: The Commerce Department said consumer prices rose 3.8% from a year earlier, up from 3.6% in September, even as gas price increases slowed.

business.b: After strong quarterly earnings, the discount retailer says adding items above a dollar lets it offer more brands, price points and pack sizes.

science.b: Researchers found the 50 species of pygopod geckos, from Australia and New Guinea, show diet and body diversity patterns that resemble snakes'.
science.title: Australia's legless geckos evolved like snakes did

science.b: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy 1,000,000 orbital compute modules, called Starmind, to meet growing demand for AI computing.

goodnews.h: Little Free Bakeries bring neighbors together

local.h: Bill would let crash victims track NYPD investigations online

local.title: Community board votes to replace iconic Tompkins Square Park pull-up bars

local.title: Rikers detainees were routinely strip-searched in violation of policy, monitor finds

periods.text: Rain, mainly before 1am. The rain could be heavy at times.  Temperature rising to around 60 by midnight. Windy, with a northeast wind 28 to 33 mph becoming east 14 to 19 mph after midnight. Winds could gust as high as 55 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 100%. New precipitation amounts between 1 and 2 inches possible.

periods.text: A 40 percent chance of rain, mainly after 1pm.  Mostly cloudy, with a temperature falling to around 54 by 3pm. Breezy, with a south wind 17 to 21 mph.

periods.name: Friday Night
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, with a low around 48. Breezy, with a west wind 18 to 20 mph.

periods.name: Saturday

periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 46.

localgood.h: Van Wyck expansion wraps before Thanksgiving
